_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — declares the 'General' app-settings entry (route → the in-app Settings page). It is NOT a normal menu group: menu-layout.json#settingsSection lists its id, so applySettingsSection in main.js lifts it (and all config/master-data pages) into Nextcloud's settings foldout (the bottom-left gear, NcAppNavigationSettings, OUTSIDE the scrollable nav). The legacy section:settings footer 'Settings' item stays removed via menu-layout.json#removals; 'Personal settings' is auto-prepended by CnAppNav.
_meta.description: The 'General' app-settings entry for the Nextcloud settings foldout (see menu-layout.json#settingsSection).
